name: admin-splash-switch
description: Admin panel -> Config -> 'Post view splash': verify the device-local switch flips the active post-view splash between 'court' and 'classic', persists to localStorage, and resets to the shipped default. Runs as u/bob (admin) - the DBG console and admin panel are admin-gated.

steps._comment: DBG + admin panel are admin-only; whoever ran last may not be an admin (carol is not).
DBG toggle is admin-gated (App.jsx gates on isAdmin) - run as an admin user e.g. bob

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); if (!el) throw new Error('no debug input'); if (el.value !== 'admin') { const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, 'admin'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.focus(); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true })); return 'submitted'; })()
steps.name: press Enter on 'admin'

steps._comment: Config tab hosts both the server feature flags and the local splash switch
ASSERT: switch renders. It sits ABOVE the flags block and is rendered in both ConfigPanel branches, so it must appear even if the flag fetch fails.

steps.name: baseline (expect court ACTIVE, no stored override)

steps._comment: Switch the post view to the original galaxy splash
ASSERT: classic became ACTIVE. Times out (= failure) if the click did not take.
ASSERT: court went inactive - the two are mutually exclusive, not both-on

steps.expression: (() => { const v = window.localStorage.getItem('fw_inline_splash'); if (v !== 'classic') throw new Error('override not persisted: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); return 'persisted=' + v; })()
steps.name: ASSERT override written to localStorage

steps._comment: 'Follow shipped default' - clears the device override
ASSERT: back to DEFAULT_SPLASH ('court'). Also leaves this device clean for later tests.

steps.expression: (() => { const v = window.localStorage.getItem('fw_inline_splash'); if (v !== null) throw new Error('override not cleared: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); return 'cleared'; })()
steps.name: ASSERT override removed from localStorage
